caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur with a large, spiked rowel consisting of eight pointed spokes radiating from a central hub. The spur is predominantly brown and metallic in color, with shading and highlights giving it a slightly aged, worn appearance. The main body of the spur is curved, designed to fit around a boot heel, and it terminates in two rectangular openings on the right side, which are probably attachment points for straps. The background is plain and off-white, causing the object to stand out clearly with no additional elements or decorations present.
title: Spur
